items.title: [northernag.net] Montana ranch wins $10,000 conservation award for stewardship
items.content_html: Dale and Janet Veseth of Veseth Ranch near Malta received the 2026 Montana Leopold Conservation Award for their management of soil, water and wildlife habitat. The award was presented Nov. 16 at the Montana Farm Bureau’s annual convention and includes $10,000. Conservation measures at the ranch include wildlife-friendly fencing, water projects and rotational grazing. In 2025, the Veseths said they would donate 38,300 acres of native rangeland to the Ranchers Stewardship Alliance when they end their ranching careers.

items.title: [agrarheute.com] Danish farmer plans to add 33,000 laying hens
items.content_html: A Danish farmer with 2,100 Jersey cows and 2,300 hectares plans to add 33,000 laying hens as part of a 20-year strategy for his family business. Milk accounts for about 75% of the business, beef 15% and crop farming 10%. Sweden counted 8,043,862 chickens in 2024, up 58.8% from 2005, while cattle, pigs and sheep declined nationally. In Poland, a poultry farm culled nearly 800 tonnes of birds after a disease outbreak last year; its owner says the cull and disposal cost 8 million zlotys, compared with 5.5 million zlotys in state compensation.

items.title: [igrownews.com] Yara launches U.S. biostimulants as research tests crop benefits
items.content_html: Yara North America has launched two biostimulants for U.S. growers, while a separate review of field research found that some seaweed-based products may improve crop performance, particularly when nitrogen inputs are reduced. The products are intended to complement existing crop nutrition plans; Yara says returns on investment in its trials varied by crop. The review, led by New Zealand fertilizer company Ballance Agri-Nutrients, assessed 81 field trials, only three of them in New Zealand. Ballance science strategy manager Warwick Catto said results depend on the crop, formulation, application rate, timing, soil and season. He said further testing against standard practice is needed to establish where the products deliver value.
